title: DOW-UAP-D74, Mission Report, Syria, November 2023
doc_notes: This document is a declassified USCENTCOM Mission Report (MISREP) detailing an ISR mission in Syria that included a UAP observation.

incidents.summary: A U.S. military aircraft observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon shaped like a bouncy ball traveling at 424 knots for at least 7 minutes.
incidents.quote: observed 1x prob hc uap shaped as a bouncy ball come from the south
